package.description: Automatic one-way folder mirroring for Windows.

en-US.description: Automatic one-way folder mirroring for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: FolderMirror is a lightweight Windows utility for automatic one-way folder mirroring with support for multiple source-to-destination pairs, automatic change monitoring, system tray operation, startup with Windows, drag-and-drop folder selection, and import/export of saved configurations.
en-US.name: FolderMirror
